mapper.update: /* updateBulkQuotationSamePrice */ UPDATE KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ SET STATUS = 'S1', MAINTAIN_PRICE_YN = 'Y', CH_LIST_PRICE = (SELECT RE_LIST_PRICE FROM KEP_BURQ_ITEM WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = BURQ_NO AND RFQ.ITEM_KEY_ID = ITEM_KEY_ID AND RFQ.AGENT = AGENT), PRICE_SUBMIT_USER = #{USER_ID}, STOA_DATE = SYSDATE, ITEM_TYPE = 'B', BUY_CLOSE_DATE = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,12),'YYYYMMDD') WHERE BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} AND ITEM_KEY_ID = #{ITEM_KEY_ID} AND AGENT_TYPE = 'B'
